content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and network software to telecom and media operators, not design or lifecycle software to manufacturers."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Sells CAD and product design software by subscription to manufacturers, matching PTC's core design software business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells customer service and knowledge software to enterprise service operations, not engineering or manufacturing software."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Builds and sells enterprise data storage hardware and data services, a different business from PTC's design and lifecycle software."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Sells application development, data integration and IT infrastructure tools to IT teams, not manufacturing design or lifecycle software."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells social media and customer experience software to consumer brands, unrelated to manufacturers' product design or lifecycle needs."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Runs a retail supply chain data network and EDI services between retailers and suppliers, not product design or lifecycle software."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells work management, content and records software to enterprises and government, not manufacturing design or lifecycle software."}]}
